verdict.rationale: Cloudflare ships multiple official, documented SDKs for AI-native/agentic development: the Agents SDK (npm install agents, Durable Object-backed stateful agents with MCP/scheduling/AI model support), the @cloudflare/think chat-agent harness, the Sandbox SDK for code execution, Workers AI and AI Search SDKs/bindings, plus Wrangler CLI and workers-sdk on GitHub, all with concrete code snippets and first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration specifically of the Agents SDK, Think harness, or Sandbox SDK (community evidence only covers core Workers, not these agent-specific SDKs), and no evidence of maturity/stability track record for these newer SDKs.
